Use case: collectible card illustration with storybook quality. Create ONE finished narrative scene, landscape1536×1024 PNG, opaque full-bleed from edge to edge. This is the FRONT CARD ILLUSTRATION only, without a frame, writing, UI or panels.
Reference1 defines the exact clean angular faceted character art style. Reference2 defines the warrior race: ginger-orange striped fur, cream muzzle/inner ears, dark brown paws, chunky golden armor and crimson cloth. Match their expressive big heads, short sturdy bodies and simple shapes. Do not copy either reference's standing or attacking pose.
CARD: Shield Cat / 방패냥. MOMENT: immediately after rain on a quiet battlefield, a dependable little warrior has nodded off while leaning against a huge rectangular shield studded with several arrows. The shield has caught every arrow and protects its owner. The cat's cheek rests on its upper rim, eyelids comfortably closed, shoulders drooping, seated with small paws relaxed; weight and sleepy pose must be instantly clear. Behind the sleeper, one smaller fellow ginger warrior in gold armor and crimson cloth looks at them with an incredulous raised eyebrow and folded forepaws, like 'Really, now?' No speech bubbles or sleep letters. Gentle visual comedy, no injury, blood, corpses or distress. Clear facial expression, believable shield contact, separate ears and props. The shield is tall, broad and square/rectangular with a straight flat top, a dark reddish-brown wooden face and broad faceted gold rim, a few bold readable arrow shafts lodged in its front at varied angles. Do NOT replace this with the round shield in the references.
COMPOSITION: moderately low three-quarter view, intimate and story-driven, not a standing unit token. Main sleeping cat slightly right of center, its face around x58% y42%; shield around x50% y60%. Secondary companion behind at x76% y40%, smaller and subordinate. Keep the ENTIRE main head/ears, paws, shield, arrow tips and companion's face inside x24%–84% and y18%–83%. The central70% contains all storytelling. The top7% and bottom7% are expendable background only: no face, ears, paws, arrow tips or important props in those strips. Cropping about7% from both top and bottom must preserve the whole story and protagonist. Keep the upper-left fifth visually quiet for a cost overlay: cool plain far sky and distant low battlefield shapes, no characters, arrows or focal highlights there. Full scene continues outside the safe area naturally.
TIME AND MOOD: clearing late-afternoon rain. A single warm light from UPPER LEFT catches the sleepy ginger face and gold rim against a cool slate-blue/lavender cloud bank. A small flat puddle catches one simple warm stepped reflection, no painted shine. Quiet rolling field in the distance, one or two distant bent standards with no emblems or lettering, distant shapes pale and simplified. Dark flat grass and a broken branch silhouette frame only the extreme lower left and lower right, do not cover the faces or shield. Depth uses clear overlapping flat planes and pale far silhouettes. Limit scene to3–4 major hue families: cool slate blue, warm gold, orange fur, crimson cloth. No photographic rendering, physical texture, brushes, haze blur or light bloom. Atmosphere, puddle reflections and clouds use hard-edged2–3 tone stepped planes. Large intentional shapes, restrained details, strong visual story at300px width. No text, letters, numerals, signature, watermark, borders, tiny decorations or UI.
Clean indie flat vector illustration matching the style reference warrior exactly: angular faceted planes with straight hard edges, like folded paper or cut gems, two to four tones per material, single light source from the upper left. Bold dramatic silhouette, same body proportions and exaggeration as the reference. No rounded blobby shapes, no gradients, no texture, no grain, no noise, no glow, no blur, no black outlines. Crisp clean edges, opaque full-bleed background. Simple eyes like the reference with one clear white highlight at the upper left (only the awake companion; the sleeping cat's eyes are closed). Smallest details at least10 px wide.

Use case: collectible card battle illustration with storybook quality. ONE finished new landscape scene, native1536×1024 PNG, fully opaque edge-to-edge. No card frame, text, numbers, UI, signature or watermark.
REFERENCE ROLES: image1 is the earlier Shield Cat card: preserve its approved angular character style, illustration finish, warm/cool light balance and layered depth ONLY. Replace the old orange cat, resting pose, wooden shield and peaceful scene completely. Image2 is the style warrior reference: use its facial-shape family and clean faceted planes, NOT its orange fur or specific slim build. Image3 is the assassin race costume reference ONLY for the attacking enemy fragments: dark teal cloth and coral accents.
NEW SHIELD CAT APPEARANCE (mandatory): a VERY BIG, ROUND, broad-bodied, heavyset cute cat, clearly wider and heavier than the old ginger soldier. White-based fur with a few HUGE ASYMMETRICAL BLACK COW PATCHES: one black ear, a large black patch around ONE eye/one side of head, other cheek mostly white, black patches on visible limbs or tail. NOT a ginger cat, not tabby, not symmetric panda eye patches, no tiny speckled spots. Sleepy half-lidded eyes; same recognizable angular feline face language as references. Open face and visible cow markings. Thick heavy STEEL PLATE armor: broad SILVER-GRAY steel surfaces with chunky GOLD edging and CRIMSON cloth/scarf/tabard. Steel stays steel, not all-gold armor. Large articulated plates, few bold rivets, no ornate royal crown. Thick sturdy planted legs.
HIS SHIELD: a massive CAT-HEIGHT TOWER SHIELD, tall rectangular silhouette, thick SILVER-GRAY STEEL face with broad faceted GOLD perimeter, solid weight, no wooden planks. Shield planted deeply and firmly into the earth, lower edge biting into stone and dirt. It covers most of the body but the cow-marked sleepy face and broad shoulders remain visible beside/above its right edge. One paw braces its handle/upper rim; broad feet brace behind it.
EXACT STORY INSTANT: assassin cats rush in from several directions and their daggers and arrows strike the planted tower shield AT THIS VERY MOMENT. The big defender is barely impressed: he is trying to stifle a yawn, sleepy drooping eyelids and a small stretched yawning mouth, one paw politely covering part of his mouth. He is standing braced and blocking, NOT asleep, NOT sitting, NOT resting his head on the shield, NOT roaring angrily. The funny contrast is frantic attack versus unbothered yawning defense.
ENEMIES: enemy assassins only as PARTIAL FIGURES / silhouettes at the frame edges, never equal-sized full characters. Different race clothing: dark teal and coral, no gold/crimson warrior armor. At least two visibly different attack directions: from the lower-left foreground a dark paw in teal sleeve drives a dagger into the FRONT of the steel shield; from the upper-right a small leaping hood silhouette with coral scarf swings a dagger toward its upper corner; an arrow from the left strikes the shield near the first impact. One attacker can have gray-brown fur to differ from the white/black defender. Do not add an identical ally behind him. All blades clearly hit steel, never penetrate a cat. No blood, wounds, injury marks, severed parts or gore. Surprised/recoiling enemy gesture is fine.
MOVEMENT AND COMPOSITION: dramatic low three-quarter camera. Strong diagonal lines of attackers and ground, contrasting the squat grounded defender and huge shield. Use broad hard-edged flat speed planes, a few large pale angular impact slashes/sparks, flying stone chips and a snapped arrow fragment to make the shield collision unmistakable. NEVER use photographic motion blur, glow, soft light streaks, printed comic lettering or decorative clutter. Keep the action legible at300px width. The shield and yawning face dominate; enemy fragments remain subordinate.
CROP SAFETY IS MANDATORY: all important main-character ears, face, mouth-covering paw, other paw, feet, tower-shield outline and impact points fit inside x23%–83%, y18%–83%. Main cow face roughly x65% y36%; shield roughly x46% y56%; feet and shield bottom no lower than83%. Top8% and bottom8% must contain ONLY expendable sky/ground/loose chips. Both8% strips will be cropped later to a roughly1.77:1 card view. No face, ear, paw, important weapon contact or shield corner may cross those strips. Peripheral enemy silhouettes may run out of the side edges. Keep upper-left fifth calm distant sky/field, free of heads or impact effects for the cost overlay.
LIGHT AND DEPTH: same quality as approved first illustration: one warm upper-left key light across white fur, silver steel and gold edging, cool slate-blue/lavender battlefield behind. Dark flat foreground stone silhouettes frame lower corners, pale layered distant field and ruins recede behind the battle. Limit major hue families to cool steel/slate, warm gold, crimson cloth, and dark teal/coral enemy accents. White/black cow coat remains unmistakable. All light, dust and atmosphere are broad flat2–3 tone planes. No texture, grain, noise or blurred haze.
Clean indie flat vector illustration matching the style reference warrior exactly: angular faceted planes with straight hard edges, like folded paper or cut gems, two to four tones per material, single light source from the upper left. Bold dramatic silhouette, same body proportions and exaggeration as the reference (same large-head short-leg style family, with the expressly specified wider and rounder Shield Cat build). No rounded blobby shapes, no gradients, no texture, no grain, no noise, no glow, no blur, no black outlines. Crisp clean edges, opaque full-bleed background. Simple eyes like the reference with one clear white highlight at the upper left. Smallest details at least10 px wide.

Edit reference1 (the full original battlefield image with the large cow-pattern Shield Cat yawning behind a tower shield while two assassins attack). Reference2 shows the project's ORIGINAL clean vector rendering, not a character to insert. Use reference1 as the exact COMPOSITION and POSE base. Retain the same large adult Shield Cat with black-and-white cow patches, broad heavy armored body, sleepy yellow eyes, yawning mouth covered by its right forepaw, LEFT FOREPAW RESTING ON THE TOP OF THE SHIELD, both hind paws PLANTED under the body in the same squat/kneeling posture. ONLY CHANGES:
- Remove BOTH assassin cats and ALL their visible parts, including the lower-left foreground assassin and the upper-right leaping assassin. Fill these areas with coherent quiet ground and sky continuing the original background.
- Replace the battered tower shield with a BRAND NEW pristine version of the SAME tall rectangular tower shield, same size/design and gold crown motif, clean intact silver-steel front and broad gold rim. Remove every arrow, knife, scratch, chip, crack, dent, flying fragment, spark and impact flash. Keep only the hero's resting paw on its top edge.
- Clean the rendering throughout. Match reference2's clean intentional vector surfaces. Remove random noisy facets, multicolored grain, color noise, dirty blotches, gritty brush marks and surface textures. Use LARGE controlled hard-edged polygon planes and 2–4 FLAT SOLID colors per material. Each plane must be internally uniform, with no tiny hue speckles or mottling. Steel: a few broad silver/slate planes. Gold: 3 broad golden tones. White and black fur: simple clear planes. Eyes: solid yellow iris shape and solid dark pupil, no extra reflections or marks. Cloak: broad crimson folds, not hundreds of little triangles. Ground and clouds also simplified into calm broad flat shapes. Preserve warm upper-left light and cool distant blue-purple layers using stepped color shapes only.
Preserve original battlefield ruins and distant crimson banners, no extra characters. No active fighting. No text, logo, sleep symbols, panel, QA guide, frame or border. No blood or wounds.

Landscape1536×1024 full-bleed opaque PNG. Keep complete shield, hero ears, face and grounded paws inside the central safe vertical area y15%–89%, so cropping the top8% and bottom8% preserves all important forms.
